title: Review non-null assertion
why: A non-null assertion suppresses TypeScript's null check and can move a mistaken invariant into a runtime failure.
suggestion: Narrow the value with a guard or encode the invariant in its type; reserve assertions for values guaranteed by construction.
limitations: Detects postfix assertions after masking comments and literals; repeated evidence is grouped per file. A finding is a review of an assertion, not proof of a null dereference: local guards, parser invariants, collection membership and framework construction contracts may justify it and are not generally resolved.

Explicit Biome noNonNullAssertion and Deno lint.rules include/exclude policy and Deno file or next balanced-node no-non-null-assertion directives are honored. Deno takes precedence at the same directory; configuration extends, tags, file overrides, and unusual unbraced multiline directive targets are not resolved.
